rules.statement: A deed conveying land to a donee with certain conditions, including the right of the donor to receive rent in lieu of rent, does not pass title if those conditions are not met.
rules.supporting_quote: "The part of the deed which I have recited leaves no room for doubt, but that the defendant was only in the position of a person entitled to occupation of the premises, provided and only so long as he paid a rent of Rs. 40 to Nei Zulaikkha."
